name: Metamagic Rod, Echoing
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser echoing metamagic rod 14,000 gp
Echoing metamagic rod 54,000 gp
Greater echoing metamagic rod 121,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that can be cast an additional time that day as if using the Echoing Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Echoing Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser echoing metamagic rod 7,000 gp
Echoing metamagic rod 27,000 gp
Greater echoing metamagic rod 60,750 gp
